name: Nezumicon
source:
Due to personal reasons, our protagonist had to leave the country where he used to live. Homeless and hungry, he finds a gigantic mansion, made for people many times his size. To be surrounded by giantesses could be dangerous, but there's no way back!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/nezumicon]Patreon[/url]]
